description: This file defines a SigIntWatcher class for handling SIGINT signals, including managing duplicate signals from npm/npx, and a FixedNodeSIGINTHandler class for installing, uninstalling, and dispatching SIGINT handlers.

classes.name: SigIntWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches for SIGINT signals and provides a promise that resolves when a signal is received.

classes.name: FixedNodeSIGINTHandler
classes.description: A class managing SIGINT signal handlers, including installation, removal, and dispatching signals, with handling for duplicate signals from npm/npx.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns a promise that resolves when a SIGINT signal is received.

methods.name: hadSignal
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether a SIGINT signal has been received.

methods.name: _dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches SIGINT signals to registered handlers, with logic to ignore duplicate signals within a timeout.

methods.name: _install
methods.description: Installs the SIGINT handler if not already installed.

methods.name: _uninstall
methods.description: Removes the SIGINT handler if installed.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers a handler for SIGINT signals.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Unregisters a handler for SIGINT signals.
